title: Jamaican Keto Skewers
description: Grilled Jamaican skewers made with keto-friendly ingredients, perfect for a quick and easy dinner.

ingredients.name: Flax eggs
ingredients.notes: 1/4 cup flaxseed meal + 6 tablespoons water, mixed and allowed to gel for 5 minutes

ingredients.name: Seedy bun-less burgers
ingredients.notes: use a store-bought or homemade keto-friendly bun-less burger patty

instructions: 2. In a small bowl, mix together the Jamaican jerk seasoning and flax eggs.
3. Add the seedy bun-less burgers to the jerk seasoning mixture and mix until well coated.
4. Thread the seasoned burgers onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each burger.
5. Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
6. While the skewers are cooking, melt the decadent cheese in a saucepan over low heat.
7. Once the skewers are cooked, brush the melted cheese over the top of each burger.
9. Optional: serve with a side of keto-friendly veggies, such as grilled asparagus or bell peppers.
